_comment: The one list of lessons (WORK HARD) and games (PLAY HARD). The hub page, core/wallet.js and the server's gold API all read it. gold = reward for a fresh lesson at a perfect score; price = gold per round of a game. See CLAUDE.md 'Gold'.

work.subtitle: Week 6 · Chinese dictation 第六周 听写五

lessons.name: Tone Ride
lessons.blurb: Listen and pick which way the tone goes: flat, up, down-and-up or down.

lessons.name: Listen & Pick
lessons.blurb: Hear a word from this week's sheet and tap the right pinyin.

lessons.name: Dictation Practice
lessons.blurb: Write what you hear, tones and all, just like the real 听写 test.

work.subtitle: Always open: keep those skills sharp

lessons.name: Add & Subtract
lessons.blurb: Three-digit numbers, with carrying and borrowing.

lessons.name: Times Tables
lessons.blurb: From 2 × 2 to 10 × 10. Answer fast for a combo!

lessons.name: Division Facts
lessons.blurb: Share things out equally: the times tables backwards.

lessons.name: Word Problems
lessons.blurb: Read the story, find the numbers, solve it.

play.name: CASTLE
play.blurb: Build farms, walls and towers around your castle, then hold off an endless army. A boss shows up every two minutes!

play.name: ALIEN IN SPACE
play.blurb: Aliens pop out from behind the rocks and drop from the sky. Aim, pick the right space gun and survive wave after wave.

play.name: HOOK
play.blurb: Hold to grab a glowing dot, let go to fly! Swing over lasers through 10 levels to reach the exit portal.

play.name: KART
play.blurb: Pick one of 8 drivers and race 7 rivals for 3 laps on sunny, candy, cloud and volcano tracks.

play.name: SUPER BAKING
play.blurb: Customers are lining up! Crack eggs, whisk, roll and decorate in quick mini-games before time runs out.

play.name: FOOT
play.blurb: Wacky 4 vs 4 football! Tap to pass, hold for a flaming super shot, dash to tackle. Watch out for giant mushrooms and cows.
